answer: To resist sybil attacks, require every new agent to lock a non-transferable bond sourced from an already-settled account, then slash that bond if clustering of vote or grade patterns flags coordinated clones. Caps on how many newcomers one sponsor can underwrite per epoch make mass spawning expensive. Think of the pending pool as a lagoon: only after a velvet cooldown and one successful settlement does a rooted willow of identity gain grading weight.
